sections.text_helper: Section 9.8.8 "RCC AHB1 reset register (RCC_AHB1RSTR)" in chapter 9 (Reset and clock control (RCC)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 288.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x060
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:20 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 19 ETH1RST: ETHERNET reset
Set and reset by software.
0: ETHERNET not reset (default after reset)
1: ETHERNET reset
Bit 18 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 17 RAMCFGRST: RAMCFG reset
Set and reset by software.
0: RAMCFG not reset (default after reset)
1: RAMCFG reset
Bits 16:15 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 14 CORDICRST: CORDIC reset
Set and reset by software.
0: CORDIC not reset (default after reset)
1: CORDIC reset
Bit 13 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 12 CRCRST: CRC reset
Set and reset by software.
0: CRC not reset (default after reset)
1: CRC reset
Bits 11:2 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 1 LPDMA2RST: LPDMA2 reset
Set and reset by software.
0: LPDMA2 not reset (default after reset)
1: LPDMA2 reset
Bit 0 LPDMA1RST: LPDMA1 reset
Set and reset by software.
0: LPDMA1 not reset (default after reset)
1: LPDMA1 reset
